channel.title: Congress Report Card weekly digest
channel.description: Missed votes, grade changes and bills that became law, every Saturday.

item.title: Week ending October 17, 2026
item.description:
Here is what changed in the public record of Congress from October 10 to October 17, 2026.

Votes this week

Neither chamber held a roll-call vote this week.

Bills that became law

  • S 195: American Music Tourism Act of 2025. Sponsored by Marsha Blackburn (R, TN).
  • S 240: Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Amendments Act of 2025. Sponsored by Steve Daines (R, MT).
  • S 2403: Retire through Ownership Act. Sponsored by Roger Marshall (R, KS).

Grade changes

16 members moved to a different letter grade. Bill scores are ranked within each chamber, so a grade can move when other members' records change.

Biggest gains

  • David J. Taylor (R, OH-2): B to B+
  • Matt Van Epps (R, TN-7): C- to C
  • Mike Flood (R, NE-1): B- to B
  • Andrew S. Clyde (R, GA-9): C- to C
  • Ashley Hinson (R, IA-2): B- to B

Biggest drops

  • Derek Schmidt (R, KS-2): B to B-
  • Richard Hudson (R, NC-9): B- to C+
  • Robert F. Onder, Jr. (R, MO-3): C+ to C
  • Lloyd Smucker (R, PA-11): C+ to C
  • Troy Downing (R, MT-2): B+ to B

See every member's grade at congressreportcard.org, or read how grades are calculated.
